comment: Declared before any G4EmCalculator output exists (2026-11-21). Kernel = hep-simkernels NumPy; Geant4 = G4EmCalculator::ComputeDEDX with cut DBL_MAX, FTFP_BERT_EMZ, mu- and mu+; PDG = validation/tables/pdg_muon.json.
classification: per material and process: a deviation of the kernel from PDG is a kernel defect if the kernel also departs from Geant4 by more than the kernel_vs_geant4 limit, and a Geant4-vs-PDG difference if the kernel agrees with Geant4 within it while Geant4 departs from PDG
